insights.summary: Dual-curve beam configuration with CurveSize0=-9.83 and CurveSize1=8.43 achieves seamless singularity convergence without clipping camera frustum.
Applying Drag=22.0 coupled with instantaneous 0.2s burst lifetimes prevents disc particles from outrunning the character hitbox during dashes.
Partitioning explosion emitters into primary shockwave (30%) and ambient sparks (70%) preserves 60 FPS on low-end mobile devices while maintaining visual density.

insights.topic: Water Bubble Trio Mist Velocity Inheritance
insights.summary: Setting VelocityInheritance=0.65 on bubble emitters locks the fluid trail directly to the caster's RootPart during high-speed character navigation.
Randomizing particle rotation speed (-360 to 360 deg/sec) with high emission bursts mimics hyper-fast electric arc discharge paths.
